modules.name: Basic immune
modules.blurb: The four markers that separate B cells, T cells, macrophages and all leukocytes in tissue.

modules.name: Tissue architecture

modules.name: Functional state
modules.blurb: Proliferation, Tregs, PD-1 / PD-L1 and cytotoxic activity (Ki-67, FoxP3, PD-1, PD-L1, Granzyme B).

modules.name: Myeloid / macrophages
modules.blurb: Macrophage, monocyte, dendritic-cell and granulocyte markers, including M2-like CD163.

modules.name: Lymphoid
modules.blurb: CD4 and CD8 T-cell subsets, B cells and NK cells.

modules.name: Stromal
modules.blurb: Fibroblasts, smooth muscle and extracellular matrix.

modules.blurb: TIL phenotyping kit.

modules.blurb: Activation-state markers kit.

modules.name: Cell segmentation kit
modules.blurb: Membrane / cytoplasm / nucleus stains on Pt 195, 196, 198 for automated cell segmentation.

modules.name: Neurophenotyping kit
modules.blurb: Neurons, astrocytes, microglia, oligodendrocytes.

modules.name: Cytotoxic mediators
modules.blurb: Granzyme B, perforin and degranulation.

modules.name: Cytokine core
modules.blurb: Intracellular IFN-γ, TNF, IL-2, IL-17A and IL-4 after stimulation.

modules.name: Immune checkpoint core
modules.blurb: PD-1, TIM-3, LAG-3, TIGIT, CTLA-4 and their ligands.

modules.name: T-cell profiling
modules.blurb: Naive / memory / effector differentiation and helper subsets.

modules.name: Broad immune profiling
modules.blurb: Twenty-marker backbone covering every major immune lineage and T-cell memory subsets.

modules.name: TBMNK + granulocytes
modules.blurb: The minimal backbone - T, B, monocytes, NK and granulocytes - in nine markers.

modules.name: Direct Immune Profiling Assay (MDIPA)
modules.blurb: The 30-marker dry-format immune profiling assay. 37 immune populations from whole blood or PBMC in one tube.

modules.name: Regulatory T cells
modules.blurb: Treg identification and function (CD25, CD127, FoxP3, CTLA-4, Helios).

modules.name: T helper phenotyping
modules.blurb: Th1 / Th2 / Th17 / Tfh by chemokine receptors.

modules.name: B-cell phenotyping
modules.blurb: Naive, memory, transitional and plasmablast B cells.

modules.name: Cell cycle
modules.blurb: IdU, cyclin B1, pHistone H3 and pRb for cell-cycle phase.

modules.name: Signalling I
modules.blurb: Phospho-flow core (pSTAT, pERK, pS6, pAKT).

modules.name: T cells
modules.blurb: All T cells, with the B-cell negative that keeps the CD3 gate clean.

modules.name: CD4 helper T cells
modules.blurb: Helper T cells. CD8 is included so CD4 and CD8 subsets separate cleanly.

modules.name: CD8 cytotoxic T cells
modules.blurb: Cytotoxic T cells. Add Granzyme B / Perforin for function.

modules.name: Naive / memory T-cell subsets
modules.blurb: CD45RA and CCR7 split naive, central memory, effector memory and TEMRA; in tissue CD45RA / CD45RO do the naive vs memory split.
modules.definition: naive CD45RA+ CCR7+ · Tcm CD45RA- CCR7+ · Tem CD45RA- CCR7- · TEMRA CD45RA+ CCR7- (tissue - CD45RO+ memory)

modules.name: Regulatory T cells (Treg)
modules.blurb: Tregs by the CD25 / CD127 gate confirmed with FoxP3.

modules.name: T-helper subsets (Th1 / Th2 / Th17)
modules.blurb: Chemokine-receptor gating of helper subsets on memory CD4 T cells.
modules.definition: Th1 CXCR3+ CCR6- · Th2 CCR4+ CXCR3- CCR6- · Th17 CCR6+ CCR4+ CXCR3- (on CD4+ memory)

modules.name: Follicular helper T cells (Tfh)
modules.blurb: Circulating Tfh by CXCR5 and PD-1 on memory CD4 T cells.

modules.name: γδ T cells
modules.blurb: γδ T cells straight from the TCR; add Vδ2 clones on request.

modules.name: MAIT cells
modules.blurb: Mucosal-associated invariant T cells by the semi-invariant TCR and CD161.

modules.name: Invariant NKT cells
modules.blurb: Type I NKT cells by the invariant TCR; CD56 separates them from NK-like T cells.

modules.name: Tissue-resident memory T cells (Trm)
modules.blurb: Trm in dissociated tissue by CD69 and CD103.

modules.name: B cells
modules.blurb: All B cells; CD20 drops on plasmablasts so both markers are worth carrying.

modules.name: Naive / memory B-cell subsets
modules.blurb: IgD and CD27 split naive from memory; CD38 / CD24 add transitional cells and plasmablasts.
modules.definition: naive IgD+ CD27- · unswitched memory IgD+ CD27+ · switched memory IgD- CD27+ · transitional CD24hi CD38hi

modules.name: Plasmablasts / plasma cells
modules.blurb: Antibody-secreting cells by CD27 / CD38, with CD20 as the negative and CD138 for mature plasma cells.
modules.definition: CD19lo CD27hi CD38hi CD20- (CD138+ plasma cells)

modules.name: NK cells
modules.blurb: Natural killer cells and their bright / dim split. CD3 keeps NKT cells out. CD56 is not sold as an IMC conjugate, so in tissue it goes in as a custom conjugation.
modules.definition: CD3- CD56+ (CD56bright CD16- · CD56dim CD16+ CD57+)

modules.name: Innate lymphoid cells (ILC)
modules.blurb: Lineage-negative CD127+ cells split by CRTH2 and c-kit.
modules.definition: Lin- CD127+ (ILC2 CRTH2+ · ILC3 CD117+ · ILC1 CRTH2- CD117-)

modules.name: Monocytes
modules.blurb: The three monocyte subsets from CD14 and CD16 on HLA-DR+ cells.
modules.definition: HLA-DR+ (classical CD14+ CD16- · intermediate CD14+ CD16+ · non-classical CD14lo CD16+)

modules.name: Dendritic cells
modules.blurb: Dendritic cells are what is left of HLA-DR+ after the lineage negatives, split into conventional (CD11c) and plasmacytoid (CD123, suspension only).
modules.definition: Lin- (CD3- CD19- CD14- CD56-) HLA-DR+ · cDC CD11c+ · pDC CD123+ (cDC1 CD141+)

modules.name: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells (pDC)
modules.blurb: pDC by CD123 and BDCA-2; CD11c separates them from conventional DCs.

modules.name: Macrophages
modules.blurb: Tissue macrophages; CD163 / CD206 flag the M2-like, tumour-associated phenotype.

modules.name: Cytotoxic lymphocytes (tissue)
modules.blurb: Where NK and CD8 T cells are actively cytotoxic - the readout most IMC immuno-oncology panels want.
modules.definition: Granzyme B+ (CD8+ T · CD3- NK) Perforin+

modules.name: Proliferating cells
modules.blurb: Cycling cells of any lineage; pair with a lineage marker to ask "which cells are dividing?".

modules.name: Neutrophils
modules.blurb: Neutrophils in whole blood or tissue; absent from Ficoll PBMC unless low-density.

modules.name: Eosinophils
modules.blurb: Eosinophils by Siglec-8 on CD66b+ granulocytes; CD16 excludes neutrophils.

modules.name: Basophils
modules.blurb: Basophils by FcεRI and CD123 without HLA-DR (which separates them from pDC).

modules.name: Mast cells
modules.blurb: Tissue mast cells by c-kit and FcεRI.

modules.name: Haematopoietic stem / progenitor cells
modules.blurb: CD34+ progenitors, with CD38 to separate the stem-cell fraction.
modules.definition: Lin- CD34+ (CD38- HSC · CD38+ progenitors) CD117+

modules.name: Platelets and red cells (exclusion)
modules.blurb: Not immune cells, but worth a channel each so platelet-bound and red-cell events can be gated out.

modules.name: Epithelial / tumour cells
modules.blurb: Carcinoma and normal epithelium.

modules.name: Endothelial cells / vessels
modules.blurb: Blood vessels by CD31 / CD34; Podoplanin adds lymphatic vessels.

modules.name: Fibroblasts / CAFs
modules.blurb: Stromal fibroblasts and activated CAFs.

modules.name: T cells (mouse)
modules.blurb: T cells and the CD4 / CD8 split.

modules.name: Regulatory T cells (mouse)
modules.blurb: Murine Tregs by CD25 and FoxP3.

modules.name: Naive / memory T cells (mouse)
modules.blurb: CD44 and CD62L split murine naive, central-memory and effector-memory T cells.
modules.definition: naive CD44lo CD62L+ · central memory CD44hi CD62L+ · effector memory CD44hi CD62L-

modules.name: B cells (mouse)
modules.blurb: Murine B cells by CD19 and B220.

modules.name: NK cells (mouse)
modules.blurb: NK cells by NK1.1 (B6) or NKp46 (all strains); CD3 excludes NKT.
modules.definition: CD3- NK1.1+ NKp46+ (C57BL/6; use NKp46 on BALB/c)

modules.name: Monocytes (mouse)
modules.blurb: Murine monocyte subsets by Ly-6C, with Ly-6G to exclude neutrophils.
modules.definition: CD11b+ Ly-6C hi (classical) / Ly-6C lo (non-classical) Ly-6G-

modules.name: Neutrophils (mouse)
modules.blurb: Murine neutrophils by Ly-6G.

modules.name: Macrophages (mouse)
modules.blurb: Murine macrophages by F4/80; CD206 flags the M2-like phenotype.

modules.name: Dendritic cells (mouse)
modules.blurb: Conventional DCs by CD11c and MHC class II; XCR1 marks cDC1.
modules.definition: CD11c+ MHC-II+ (cDC1 XCR1+ · cDC2 CD11b+) F4/80-

modules.name: Eosinophils (mouse)
modules.blurb: Murine eosinophils by Siglec-F.

modules.name: Stem / progenitor cells (mouse LSK)
modules.blurb: The LSK gate for murine bone-marrow progenitors.

modules.name: Immune lineage backbone (human)
modules.blurb: Every major leukocyte lineage. Start here for any human blood panel.

modules.name: T-cell differentiation
modules.blurb: Naive, central memory, effector memory and TEMRA; senescence and IL-7 responsiveness.

modules.name: T-cell activation and exhaustion
modules.blurb: Recent activation plus the checkpoint receptors that define exhausted and tumour-reactive T cells.

modules.name: Regulatory T cells
modules.blurb: Tregs by CD25 / CD127 / FoxP3, with suppressive-function markers.

modules.name: NK cells
modules.blurb: CD56 bright / dim NK subsets, receptors and cytotoxic machinery.

modules.name: B cells and plasma cells
modules.blurb: Naive, memory, transitional B cells and plasmablasts.

modules.name: Intracellular cytokines
modules.blurb: Effector cytokines after PMA / ionomycin or antigen stimulation. Bright when induced; plan for high signal.

modules.name: Phospho-signalling
modules.blurb: JAK/STAT, MAPK, PI3K and NF-κB readouts for stimulation assays.

modules.name: Proliferation and cell death
modules.blurb: Cycling, mitotic and apoptotic cells.

modules.name: Tumour and stroma structure (IMC)
modules.blurb: Epithelium, mesenchyme, matrix and vessels - the map every tissue panel needs.

modules.name: Epithelium (IMC)
modules.blurb: Epithelial and tumour-cell outline - pan-cytokeratin and E-cadherin, with EpCAM and keratin subtypes to refine.

modules.name: Vessels and lymphatics (IMC)
modules.blurb: Blood vessels (CD31, CD34), vessel walls (αSMA) and lymphatics (podoplanin).

modules.name: Matrix and fibroblasts (IMC)
modules.blurb: Collagen and fibronectin for the matrix, vimentin, αSMA and FAP for the fibroblasts that lay it down.

modules.name: Nuclei and proliferation (IMC)
modules.blurb: Histone H3 for every nucleus (a segmentation aid alongside the Ir intercalator), Ki-67 for cycling cells, pHistone H3 for mitosis.

modules.name: Brain structure (IMC)
modules.blurb: Neurons (NeuN, MAP2, neurofilament, synaptophysin), astrocytes (GFAP), microglia (Iba1), oligodendrocytes and myelin (Olig2, MBP).

modules.name: Checkpoint / immuno-oncology (IMC)
modules.blurb: PD-L1 axis, antigen presentation and the cells that respond.

modules.name: Immune lineage backbone (mouse)
modules.blurb: Every major murine leukocyte lineage.

modules.name: Mouse tumour immunology (IMC)
modules.blurb: Murine tumour microenvironment - T cells, macrophages, checkpoint and structure.

modules.name: Metabolism
modules.blurb: Glycolysis, fatty-acid oxidation, amino-acid transport and mitochondrial mass.
